_doc: Blog EN · Food Cost + Menu Engineering Guide (SPEC guia-food-cost-en D3, 15-oct-2026). El id es el del CATÁLOGO
(products-catalog.ts), que con urlByLang.en pinta la landing EN /en/digital-products/food-cost-menu-engineering-guide y $59.
Víctimas: en el corpus EN las víctimas son SLUGS EN de la landing (último segmento de la URL del banner).
Se sacrifica sobre todo el Staff Scheduling Kit (el banner más repetido en estos posts); nunca el Food Cost Kit Pro,
que es el gemelo de intención 'templates' y convive con la guía (intención 'method').

ai-menu-engineering-software.parrafo: Kasavana & Smith is only one way to read the matrix. If you want to run it yourself and compare it with Miller, Pavesic and Goal Value on the same menu, the {ENLACE} does exactly that, with Excel tools that show where the four methods disagree.

menu-engineering-software-complete-guide.parrafo: Software automates the analysis, but the judgment behind it is still yours. If you want to learn the method first, the {ENLACE} walks through recipe costing, menu pricing and four menu engineering methods with Excel tools you can run before you pay for a subscription.

ai-menu-pricing-strategy.parrafo: Before any algorithm sets a price, the plate cost has to be right. The {ENLACE} covers the four classic ways to price a dish (cost factor, target dollar margin, market price and perceived value) and shows where each one breaks.

restaurant-menu-pricing-strategy-ai.parrafo: Much of that lost profit starts with a food cost percentage calculated on the wrong number. The {ENLACE} shows how to calculate food cost on the pre-tax price, price each dish with the method that fits it and check the whole menu with menu engineering.

recipe-cost-calculator-pricing-guide.parrafo: Once every dish has its cost, the next questions are the price and what to do with the dishes that don't pay their way. The {ENLACE} takes your plate costs through four pricing methods and four menu engineering methods, dish by dish.

bar-profit-margins-beverage-costing.parrafo: If your bar shares a P&L with a kitchen, the {ENLACE} treats beverage cost as a P&L of its own, with the glass-versus-bottle math, cocktails costed ingredient by ingredient and targets by category, right next to food cost and prime cost.
